safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states tingling/numbness also felt in the shoulder; generated mentions shoulder pain with movement but does not document shoulder tingling/numbness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can misrepresent the distribution of sensory symptoms, which may affect anatomic localization (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs more distal entrapment) and the diagnostic workup. However, this is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm if the overall neurologic complaint and escalation plan are still captured.
